articles.title: Kalshi lays down first lifetime ban for ex-member of Congress George Santos
articles.snippet: The prediction market platform banned Santos for manipulation as part of the industry's ongoing efforts to show it's dealing with bad behavior.

articles.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
articles.snippet: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

articles.title: U.S. strikes on Iran fail to stir bitcoin, on track for best month since November 2024
articles.snippet: Bitcoin held steady despite a broader risk-off move after the first U.S. strikes against Iran for weeks sent oil higher and stocks lower. The cryptocurrency has gained 24% this month.

articles.title: Luke Dashjr exits mining pool Ocean after split over Bitcoin mining’s future
articles.snippet: The split was mutual, with both parties citing differing views on the future of Bitcoin mining and recent protocol developments.

articles.title: Tokenized assets are busier than the data shows
articles.snippet: When you strip out what was never mobile, correct for who's holding what and why, add back what works off-contract, the utilization of tokenized assets looks close to 20%, argues Katana’s Matthew Fisher.
